audit.why: 54.01% Emerald+ over 1061 games supports FAVOURED 4/10 and the all-Vex chart.
Favoured lane: dash-reliant assassin into the anti-dash mage, snowball-or-bust scaling — content layer covers this well.
Spikes (3-5 E-punish, 6 play-around-E-not-ult, 1st item burst, late falloff) are specific and kit-grounded already.

audit.why: Kit: W carries the dash flag, 7s CD, 1100 range; E is 11-7s; R is 120s.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries E 11-7s, W 7s dash caveat, R 120s.
